tweet.text:
It’s notable that 10 hours later this post has 3M views and ~35K likes.  The former AI Czar with a popular podcast and 1.7M followers on X who posts frequently.

Yet some kid with 2 months of work experience at Anthropic, a half dozen followers and no prior posts managed to get over 100M views and 10x the likes in the same time.  And we’re expected to believe this happened organically.

Give me a break.
